title: Pituitary Histopathology and Hyperprolactinaemia and Risk of Glucose Metabolic Disturbances in Acromegaly.
brief_summary: Acromegaly is frequently associated with impaired glucose tolerance and diabetes. We hypothesise that pituitary histopathology and plasma hyperprolactinaemia could have prognostic value in predicting the risk of glucose metabolic disturbances in acromegalic patients. The aim of this study is to examine glucose metabolic outcome in acromegalic patients with and without histologically verified prolactin and growth hormone (GH) co-secreting adenomas. The study population include 79 patients who have all undergone surgical treatment for acromegaly.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of acromegaly, and treated at the department of Endocrinology, Copenhagen University Hospital, Rigshospitalet, Denmark (tertiary referral hospital), surgical treatment of acromegaly

Exclusion Criteria:

* no surgical treatment performed
study_population: Patients with acromegaly treated with surgery
